sources.title: Integrating Planning and Reacting in a Heterogeneous Asynchronous Architecture for Controlling Real-World Mobile Robots
sources.access: original proceedings PDF, page 809 image verified; sections 3.4 and 4 sampled

implemented: Reported physical and simulated robot experiments. Robbie rover test changes ordering of three supplied goals as new obstacle observations arrive.
learned: Updates its environmental model from observations; no acquisition of new primitive action types established.
designed: Reactive primitives, sequencing schemas, planning algorithms and mission goals.
limit: Replanning within a pre-existing action library is not independent goal formation or new cognitive function.
ora: Comparator separating changing knowledge of surroundings from changing the available skills.

sources.authors: Jeffrey L. Krichmar; Douglas A. Nitz; Joseph A. Gally; Gerald M. Edelman
sources.title: Characterizing functional hippocampal pathways in a brain-based device as it solves a spatial memory task
sources.access: PMC HTML methods, results, discussion and acknowledgments reviewed selectively; supplementary parameters and raw data not checked
sources.funders: Neurosciences Research Foundation; W. M. Keck Foundation; DARPA; Office of Naval Research

implemented: Darwin X physical robot with simulated nervous system; nine different network initializations on the same chassis, 16 trials each. Authors report shorter search times in later blocks and learned spatially selective unit responses.
learned: Associations between sensorimotor cues, location and successful navigation through plastic synapses. Spatial response patterns need not be explicitly assigned to individual places.
designed: Sensors, exploration and obstacle responses, target detection, anatomically inspired network topology, plasticity and reward. Positive signal initially supplied by target detector; negative signal by obstacle sensors.
limit: Nine simulated nervous systems, not nine robots. One bounded task. No independent raw-trial verification or full supplement audit. Backtracing of connected active units is not by itself counterfactual isolation. No spontaneous acquisition of the underlying reward criterion.
ora: Strong prior art for experience-dependent internal representations and multiple mechanisms producing the same behavior; distinguish acquired association from designed value function and sensorimotor scaffolding.
rights: Bibliographic facts and original analysis only; no source files, figures, or full-text redistribution.

sources.authors: Michael Sandoval; Cristina Sorice; Viet Nguyen; Marc Pomerantz; Scott Tepsuporn; Philip Bailey; Christopher Lim; Steve Schaffer; David Brown; Joshua Vander Hook; Gail Woodward; Jean-Pierre de la Croix; Amir Rahmani; Michael T. Wolf
sources.title: CARACaS multi-agent maritime autonomy for unmanned surface vehicles in the Swarm II harbor patrol demonstration
sources.access: official NASA preprint record and abstract; no full methods review

implemented: NASA records describe field demonstration of software-coordinated multi-vehicle autonomy with dynamic task assignment and human supervisory oversight.
learned: No learning of new cognitive mechanisms established by the available records; maintained situational model and task reassignment are distinct from learning.
designed: Executive, planning and perception components and mission behavior library.
limit: Author-reported autonomy performance in bounded demonstrations, not general cognition or unbounded independence; exact 2010 funding identifier must not be attributed automatically to the 2017 report.
ora: High-level evidence comparator only: dynamic task allocation does not establish newly acquired competence. No operational details or implementation guidance retained.
rights: Bibliographic facts and original analysis only; no source files, figures, or full-text redistribution.

sources.authors: Usef Faghihi; Philippe Fournier-Viger; Roger Nkambou; Pierre Poirier
sources.title: Identifying Causes Helps a Tutoring System to Better Adapt to Learners during Training Sessions
sources.access: publisher PDF first page visually verified; introduction and selected experiment passages reviewed

implemented: Tutoring model tested on scenarios in simulated Canadarm2 training; builds user models and selects interventions using a behavior network.
learned: Reported procedural refinement and association learning from user histories; authors describe finding suitable routes and removing some unnecessary graph nodes.
designed: Expert-specified task network and scenarios, pedagogical knowledge, protected nodes and valence mechanism.
limit: Some graph nodes explicitly protected by domain expert. Simulation examples do not independently establish causal identification or improved learning outcomes for real astronauts. No claim of subjective emotion.
ora: Distinguish discovering a causal relationship from adapting an authored graph or selecting among expert-provided options.
rights: Bibliographic facts and original analysis only; no source files, figures, or full-text redistribution.

sources.authors: Raúl Arrabales; Agapito Ledezma; Araceli Sanchis
sources.title: Simulating visual qualia in the CERA-CRANIUM cognitive architecture
sources.access: PubMed metadata and abstract; full chapter not accessed

implemented: Java game agent implements a shared-workspace architecture; authors report winning 2010 BotPrize edition. No independent contest result table checked here.
learned: Dynamic prioritization of perceptual processing reported; no evidence here of acquired new underlying cognitive capabilities.
designed: Specialized processes, workspace architecture and behavioral control logic.
limit: Human-like behavior judgments and a functional model labeled artificial qualia do not establish subjective experience. Full chapter and official score archive remain unreviewed.
ora: Separate externally observed human-like behavior, functional workspace access and phenomenal consciousness. These claims require distinct evidence.
rights: Bibliographic facts and original analysis only; no source files, figures, or full-text redistribution.
